from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path

program = '''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            min_r = min(y for y, x in cells)
            max_r = max(y for y, x in cells)
            min_c = min(x for y, x in cells)
            max_c = max(x for y, x in cells)
            objects.append((min_c, min_r, color, cells, max_r-min_r+1, max_c-min_c+1))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: (obj[0], obj[1]))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    top = left = 0
    for i, (min_c, min_r, color, cells, oh, ow) in enumerate(objects):
        if i:
            top += prev_h - 1
            left += prev_w - 1
        for y, x in cells:
            yy, xx = top + (y-min_r), left + (x-min_c)
            if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w:
                out[yy][xx] = color
        prev_h, prev_w = oh, ow
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
ns={}
exec(compile(program,str(p),'exec'),ns)
